title: Evaluate Design System Consistency Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for three card shadows, determine whether they represent one elevation role, inspect all states and themes, consolidate only semantic duplicates, and migrate consumers with visual regression evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A usage inventory mapping components and tokens to surfaces, variants, states, themes, and exceptions.
Rendered comparisons and source references for each confirmed consistency defect.
A consumer-aware migration plan with deprecation, tests, visual checks, and rollback.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject consistency changes based only on matching literal values.
Reject new components or variants that duplicate existing supported behaviour.
